create.name: Ronn Pawo McLane
create.bio:
Ronn Pawo McLane is a meditation teacher and author in Overland Park, Kansas. His grounding is in Tibetan Buddhism, in which he is an ordained ngakpa (a non-monastic practitioner in the Dzogchen and Mahamudra lines), and he draws on Zen and present-day mindfulness as well. He first took up meditation at thirteen and has been teaching for well over a decade. For several years he guided the Kansas City Buddhist Center as its spiritual director, leading its weekly Sunday practice and talks until the centre closed in 2023; its community now carries on through Cultivate Meditation Academy, the school he had founded before the centre opened.

His teaching is plain and practical. Rather than covering difficulty with forced cheerfulness, he asks students to stay awake to whatever is actually happening, an idea he calls brave awareness and sets out in his first book of that title. At the academy's studio in Overland Park he leads drop-in meditation and sound bath classes; online he offers self-paced courses on meditation, the foundations of Buddhism and engaged compassion, plus certification paths for people who want to teach meditation or work as mindfulness coaches. He also hosts the Brave Awareness Podcast and, before it, the Backyard Buddhist Podcast, talking with guests about carrying practice into ordinary life.

courses.title: Foundations of Meditation
courses.description: A self-paced online course for newcomers and for anyone whose practice keeps lapsing. It looks at where meditation comes from, the main styles and how they differ, posture and equipment, how a session is put together, and how to settle into a daily habit.

courses.title: Foundations of Buddhism
courses.description: An online introduction to Buddhist thought and practice taught by Ronn as an ordained ngakpa. Modules move through the core teachings and how to live them, with guided meditations and a student forum alongside.

courses.title: Compassion in Practice
courses.description: A six-part course on engaged Buddhism drawn from Dzogchen and Mahamudra practice. Each part pairs a teaching, such as the Four Noble Truths, the bodhisattva ideal or interdependence, with practices, questions for reflection and a recorded Zoom discussion group.

courses.title: Meditation Teacher Path
courses.description: A self-paced certification route for people who want to guide others in meditation. It starts with the academy's foundations course and goes on to a training in how to teach: instruction, session design, leading groups and building a teaching practice.

courses.title: Weekly In-Studio Classes
courses.description: Drop-in meditation classes at the academy's studio in Overland Park, mixing guided sits of different styles with occasional sound bath sessions. Places are reserved online.
courses.price: $25 USD drop-in; $99 USD for five classes; $69 USD a month
